name: Mitsubishi Electric Manufacturing
old_description: Known for our innovative components, Mitsubishi Electric Automotive America manufactures autonomous-ready infotainment and ADAS solutions, premium audio systems, high-definition displays, and powertrain electronics for standard, electric, and hybrid vehicles. Since 1979 we have served the major automotive, heavy-duty truck, and coach manufacturers across the US, and continue to grow each year!   Be a part of a select team that is making a real impact on the automotive mobility of tomorrow!
about:
Mitsubishi Electric Manufacturing operates from Maysville, Kentucky, where it has produced automotive electronics since 1979. The facility serves as the U.S. manufacturing base for Mitsubishi Electric Automotive America, a subsidiary of the global Mitsubishi Electric Corporation.

The plant manufactures autonomous-ready infotainment and ADAS solutions, premium audio systems, high-definition displays, and powertrain electronics for standard, electric, and hybrid vehicles. Specific production processes, facility size, headcount, and annual volumes are not disclosed in the available information.

The company supplies major automotive OEMs, heavy-duty truck manufacturers, and coach builders across the United States. Its components are integrated into passenger cars, commercial trucks, and bus platforms.

The business emphasizes innovative components and a growing role in the automotive mobility transition, though no distinct founding mission or differentiation statement beyond product focus is provided.
